pageTitle: hub by Premier Inn | London Spitalfields Brick Lane
pageDescription: Enjoy the best of trendy Shoreditch, Spitalfields Market and the City of London at our hub by Premier Inn London Spitalfields, Brick Lane hotel. Close to Liverpool Street station.
hotelDescription:
Energy pulses through Brick Lane, where warehouse art galleries, vintage boutiques, markets and festivals have transformed this notorious East End slum into a hub of diversity, creativity and culture. A feast for the senses, Brick Lane attracts London’s edgy and artistic crowd with its live music venues, trendy late night bars, vibrant street art and invitingly aromatic curry houses.

From convenient touchscreen controls that let you control your room’s lighting and temperature, to inviting double beds and high-spec en-suite bathrooms, sleek pull-out desks and plenty of under-bed storage, our stylish, compact rooms are cleverly designed around you. Catch up with friends online or watch the latest blockbuster movies through your 40" smart TV. Stay connected with super-fast, free Wi-Fi*, and experience the city at your fingertips. 

There’s a choice of two room types at this hub hotel – Standard and Bigger.
hotelDirections: The hotel is a 12 minute walk from Liverpool Street Station. Exit the station turning left onto Bishopsgate. Continue to follow Bishopsgate then turn right onto Brushfield Street. Continue to follow this road past Spitalfields Market. When  you reach the end of Brushfield Street, cross over Commercial Street and head straight along Fournier Street. The hotel will be facing you when you reach Brick Lane.
parkingDescription: hub by Premier Inn does not have a car park. We're so central we would encourage you to leave your car at home and arrive by public transport.

donations.title: Support the Disasters Emergency Committee and the humanitarian effort in Ukraine
donations.info: We’ve all seen the humanitarian crisis affecting the people of the Ukraine. Our hearts are with all those whose lives have been affected by these devastating events, and the unimaginable suffering caused by this needless human tragedy. 100% of your donation will go to The Disasters Emergency Committee (DEC) in support of their international humanitarian aid effort. It's the task of this charity to supply food, water, first aid, medicine, warm clothes, and shelter for refugees, which is why any support you can offer today will be invaluable in helping the people of Ukraine.*

restaurant.name: Proven Dough
restaurant.description: Choose from one of our tasty breakfast combos, including a bacon sandwich, cheese toastie and porridge with a hot drink or juice and fruit pot. For lunch, tuck into delicious grilled sandwiches, soups and salads. Start your night right with a tasty deli board, refreshing cocktails and an extended beer and wine menu plus olives and mixed nuts to accompany. Opening hours may vary.

menus.name: Breakfast
menus.description: Kick off your day with a continental breakfast including fresh pastries, fresh fruit, natural yoghurt, hot porridge and orange juice plus tea and coffee.
menus.disclaimer: Depending on your selected hotel and dates you stay, we will be offering different breakfast and evening options.

menus.name: Dinner
menus.description: Grab a bite to eat and tuck into favourites like nachos with chilli con carne or a delicious chicken makhani curry. All of our dishes are also available for you to take away and enjoy in your room.
menus.disclaimer: Depending on your selected hotel and dates you stay, we will be offering different breakfast and evening options.
